name: durabull
description: Administer BullMQ queues and monitor Redis health from your conversation. Diagnose backlogs, inspect jobs and workers, review schedules and alerts, retry failed jobs, and pause or resume queues on request.

interface.longDescription:
Administer BullMQ queues and monitor Redis health directly from your conversation. Built for developers and operators running background jobs, Durabull helps you diagnose backlogs, investigate failures, and recover work.

Find jobs across queues, inspect redacted payloads, results, logs and stack traces, and review throughput, workers and recurring schedules. Check Redis memory, CPU, fragmentation, clients and health history. Review incidents and notification delivery, acknowledge or resolve alerts, and snooze alert rules.

When you request a change, retry failed jobs, promote delayed jobs, or pause and resume queues. Supported MCP Apps hosts provide interactive queue, job, schedule, alert and health views.

Connect Durabull Cloud or your self-hosted installation with scoped OAuth access. You need a Durabull account and permission to access the relevant connections. The plugin supports queue operations and Redis health diagnostics; it does not execute arbitrary Redis commands, edit keys or job payloads, delete jobs, purge queues, scale workers, or create or edit schedules and alert rules.
defaultPrompt: Check my BullMQ queues for backlogs, failures and missing workers.
Find a job by ID and explain why it failed.
Show my recurring jobs and their next scheduled runs.
